verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a fair axis for an observability platform like Grafana, so the story applies. The evidence only shows that Frontend Observability captures client-side errors and that Kubernetes infrastructure issues are grouped into categories. Neither documents application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, or regression detection, so these are adjacent features rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection
